name: Kraken BTC/USD signed aggressor flow
description: Each verified buyer-aggressed Kraken BTC/USD trade contributes positive price-times-size notional and positive base size; each seller-aggressed trade contributes negative values. Outputs sum those contributions over causal 1-, 10-, and 60-second receipt-time windows of (window close minus duration, window close]. Kraken subscription-snapshot rows are excluded. Ready output requires 60 seconds of uninterrupted Kraken observation and Kraken demonstrably alive. A trade-quiet but live Kraken connection — any admitted Kraken input event within staleness_bound_ms — contributes truthful zeros (flow_direction_10s = "flat"); no admitted Kraken input within that bound keeps degrading as trade_venue_stale_or_missing. This identity is single-venue: it reads only Kraken inputs and is ready whenever Kraken is warmed and alive, independently of the other adopted spot venue. The blended `btc.external.*` reading of the same measurement stays the reference layer and continues to require every adopted venue (ADR 0024). Decimal outputs are rounded to eight places using round-half-to-even.
